summary: Linked-list iterator advance and read: reads the current node pointer stored at obj+0x24; if non-null, advances it to the node's next link at +4; then reads obj+0x24 again and returns its first DWORD when non-null, otherwise returns 0. Used by RenderDispatchWithIteration (004993D0) to step through a list. The ABI lead names it Linked_List_Field_Reader.

local_names.this: iterator container: base object pointer at +0x0
local_names.v2: current node pointer read from obj+0x24 (null when list exhausted)
local_names.v3: derived address obj+0x1C used to reach the iterator slot at obj+0x24
local_names.v4: current node pointer after the conditional advance, re-read from obj+0x24

operations.description: Read the base object pointer from *this (offset 0x0), then read the current node pointer from the iterator field at obj+0x24 into v2
Conditional advance: if the current node pointer is non-null, write the node's next link at +4 back into the iterator field at obj+0x24

Re-read the iterator field at obj+0x24; if it is non-null return the first DWORD of the current node (field at *(obj+0x24)+0), otherwise return 0. Sole caller is RenderDispatchWithIteration (004993D0); ABI lead labels it Linked_List_Field_Reader

unresolved: The semantic meaning of the node's +0 and +4 fields (value/next-link roles are inferred, not confirmed) and the list the iterator traverses are not established by this packet
